- Scope guard: no edits may spill into any other path, including `tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt`.
- Avoid unrelated cleanup/reflow in the target file; keep the change limited to the required first-line/second-line content.
- No issue/codebase conflict detected: the target file exists on the planning ref, and only the requested `decompose-run` value differs from the required value.

- Verify line 2 is exactly `decompose-run: 31763482416`.
- Confirm `git diff --stat` (or equivalent) shows only `tests/e2e_smoke_canary_b.txt` changed.
